# `gcp.authzpolicy`

AuthzPolicy is a resource that allows to forward traffic to a callout backend designed to scan the traffic for security purposes.

[networksecurity](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | networksecurity |
| Scope | regional |
| Asset type | `networksecurity.googleapis.com/AuthzPolicy` |
| Hangs off | `projects` |
| Tier | 1 (generic-safe) |
| Mutation timeout | 1200s |

| Create | yes | `POST projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/authzPolicies?authzPolicyId={{name}}` |

| Update | yes | `PATCH projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/authzPolicies/{{name}}`, with an update mask naming the changed fields |

| Import | yes | by id, see below |
